title: THE FALCON SOARS // SWEETROBIN'S SEED
narrative: Young Robert Arryn slaps the vial of sweetsleep from Maester Colemon's hand. 'No more sleep!' the sickly boy shouts, his cheeks flushed with stubborn defiance. 'Alayne says I am the Lord of the Eyrie, and bad men want me to fly! Put Petyr Baelish in the sky cells!' The guards obey their rightful lord without hesitation.

options.text: Ride down the Bloody Gate with the combined host of the Vale.
Declare the sovereign independence of the Mountain and Vale.
